methodology: SEC Form 8-K current reports — the legally mandated material-event disclosure (public domain, 17 U.S.C. §105), due within 4 business days of the event. Panel streams a bounded 50 large-cap issuer set (5 mega-cap seed + v2 20 + v3 25 across financials, payments, healthcare, staples, energy, industrials, tech/comm — breadth expansions 2026-08-22; still bounded, NOT full market; XOM carries both its pre-succession CIK and the 2026-07-01 8-K12B successor entity) since 2026-05-01; each row links the EDGAR primary document. Items are regex-extracted from the primary doc (nbsp/thin-space entities normalized) and mapped to ONE category by a rare-material-first precedence (delisting > merger completion > control change > non-reliance > officer changes > ... > exhibits); the full item list is preserved per row. Documents whose items cannot be extracted are counted as unclassified — never guessed. Filing-date point-in-time; 8-K/A amendments are new accessions (immutable). Display-only, not a research claim; NOT part of any OOS pipeline.
